content.value: . Prove that the axial temperature gradient does not depend on radial flow direction in case of uniform surface heat flux condition for a thermally fully developed flow.

7(b ). Air at atmospheric pressure and temperature of 325 K flows through a tube bundle in inline tube arrangement. Tubes have an outside diameter of 1.9 cm and are maintained at a uniform temperature of 3 7 5 K. The longitudinal and transverse pitches for the bundle are given by $\begin{array} { r } { \frac { S _ { L } } { D } = \frac { S _ { T } } { D } = 2 } \end{array}$ . The bundle consists of 15 rows, 20 tubes per row and 0.75 m long in the direction of flow. The air velocity just before the tube bank is 8 mis.
(i) Find the pressure drop across the tube bundle.
(ii) Find the exit temperature of the air.
(iii) Determine the total heat transfer rate.
